summary: Full frontend E2E testing of static site Atlas Ekraf Jakarta (http://localhost:3000/index.html). Verified every clickable element opens the rule-based interpretation modal with correct title and non-empty content, that all three close methods work, that hero hex updates the profile card, that tilegram2 hex updates the side card without opening the modal, keyboard accessibility (Enter opens, Escape closes), metric selector toggles, scroll progress bar, and search suggestion selection. No JavaScript console errors or page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Modal close animation uses a 320ms setTimeout before setting overlay.hidden=true; automated tests need >=350ms wait after triggering close. Not a bug, but noted for future testing agents.
Suggestion container id is #saran (not #saran-cari). Review request referenced #saran-cari; docs/testids could be aligned or a data-testid added for the suggestion list for easier automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site served by python http.server on port 3000 from /app. No supervisor programs used. INTERP.tutup() uses a 320ms transition delay before setting overlay.hidden=true — wait >=400ms in Playwright before asserting close. Suggestion list is #saran (children are the suggestions). Overlay backdrop covers full viewport (0,0,1920,1080); clicking at (5,5) closes it via the 'e.target === overlay' handler in interpretasi.js.
verified_features: No JS console/page errors on load
interp-overlay + interp-dialog exist and hidden on load (overlay.hidden=true)
bar-subsektor-0 click opens modal: title='Restoran', 4 stat blocks, 3 paragraphs
Close via X button, Escape key, and backdrop click all set overlay.hidden=true and restore body.style.overflow=''
kartu-klaster-0 opens modal titled 'Klaster 1 — Setiabudi' with 3 paragraphs
kartu-prioritas-Cakung opens modal titled 'Cakung' with 3 paragraphs
row-sensitivitas-0 opens modal with title starting "Moran's I"

figure-kepadatan / figure-lisa / figure-akses each open modal with correct map interpretation titles
